data.headline: AI-Driven Transformation | Professional Services & CX | Strategy & Ops | Constantly Inquisitive Seeker of Flow
data.about:
More than 20 yrs of healthcare and high tech experience in professional services, business strategy, operational effectiveness and customer experience. Skilled in the areas of vision and culture definition, service delivery and biz dev.  As a life long learner, I ask the right questions, then drive to results.
Currently I am actively researching and experimenting with peak performance and flow experiences in personal and business environments as well as longevity behaviors.

description.text: Leading the company’s enterprise-wide AI transformation initiative, focused on boosting productivity and efficiency through the use of large language models (LLMs) and generative AI across engineering, services, product management, customer success, product marketing, and sales. Reporting to the CITO, I work cross-functionally to reengineer processes, scale intelligent automation, and accelerate time-to-value. I drive strategic planning, execution, and performance tracking for AI-assisted workflows, while fostering a culture of experimentation, innovation, and operational excellence. I also lead and mentor high-performing teams, building organizational capability in modern process engineering and delivery.

As the VP of Global Professional Services at RapidAI, I lead the Implementation, Integration, and Technical Services teams, driving our mission to revolutionize stroke care and beyond by providing advanced AI imaging analysis and clinical decision support. Through collaboration, strategic planning, and problem solving, we are scaling our engagement and support services to ensure we continue to provide exceptional experience for clinicians, healthcare professionals and technologists during onboarding and ongoing use.

subComponents.title: Senior Director, Professional Services Customer Experience
subComponents.caption: Aug 2019 - Apr 2024 · 4 yrs 8 mos

description.text: As the leader of Customer Experience for Cisco's enterprise customers in western US, my team was responsible for ensuring our customers loved the services we provided and appreciated every day the relationship they had with Cisco.  Focusing on our priorities of Growth, Operational Excellence and Culture, we prospected new opportunities for our sales teams, optimized our workflow through innovation and process improvement, and supported a work environment where we had each other's back and had fun doing it.

Within Cisco’s Customer Experience organization I led the western US State, Local and Education Market. I worked with delivery managers, sales managers and technical experts to develop and support high-functioning customer success teams.  Collectively we worked with our clients to ensure their IT organizations are successful and they have the best experience with Cisco through all phases of the lifecycle.

• Redeveloped healthcare practice after two-year pause by establishing new offers and rebuilding internal and external brand through new engagements with key industry leaders such as Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, Kaiser Permanente, Dignity Health and Trinity Health; practice areas addressed care coordination, collaboration, operational efficiency, population health management and integrative care delivery.
• Sold and delivered consulting engagements to major vertical markets (healthcare, energy, retail) and managed a team of consultants (9) and a portfolio of clients including Southern California Edison, PG&E and Visa.
• Drove bookings, revenue, and profitability – achieved more than $5+M in revenue in FY13, $8+M FY14, $11+M FY15.
• As Consulting Practice Leader, managed engagements to ensure technical investments align with business goals and priorities; provided planning and design services (business plan development, business case modeling, business process re-engineering and governance frameworks); and drove adoption and absorption of technology into day-to-day business.

•	Established and implemented a Workforce Strategy for more than 20,000 engineers in 63 countries – developed decision framework, leadership definitions, talent reviews, succession planning process, site health assessment program, and metric reporting; addressed governance and policies for global site planning; evaluated investment on education based on business plans; and led change management process.
•	Conducted Annual Strategic Planning Process – orchestrated prioritization of investments; negotiated budgets and staffing levels; and collaborated with Finance and other corporate entities to formalize and report on process results.   
•	Designed and implemented Organizational Effectiveness Program – established a savings and cost avoidance model; drove data collection; expanded and scaled operations across all engineering locations.
•	Developed a Social Networking Model  to enhance Cisco internal community-building – led requirements gathering, capability design, and platform launch to improve communication and collaboration; led the introduction of change including launch communications and training; led a cross-functional team using Agile development methodology;  and achieved results beyond stretch target goals.

•	Led China Theatre Business Planning – managed cross-functional team in the development of strategy and operations planning including quality assessments, resiliency evaluations, and execution from 21 support groups (IT, HR, Revenue Process, Cash Transfer, Marketing, Sales, etc.).
•	Expanded In-Country Operations – engaged theater executives in strategic direction setting exercises; led governance of priorities, alignment of functions; and managed the $35 million budget allocated to this development effort.  
•	Managed a collaborative team representing 9 cross-functional groups – created 8 new international sales entities in Africa and Eastern Europe; and delivered analytical systems required to manage and monitor results of these new operations.
•	Launched a Technology Access Program – drove Internet growth in emerging markets; rolled out curriculum for the setup of service providers to more than 300 systems engineers in 167 countries; and led on-site development in major African markets including Nairobi, Lagos, and Lusaka.
•	Facilitated exploration and development of engineering innovations with 3 elite engineers (Cisco Fellows), industry experts, and customers – achieved recommendations for several multi-million dollar development efforts. 
•	Led Customer Advisory Board meetings – gathered input and feedback on technologies and strategic direction.

•	Facilitated exploration and development of engineering innovations with Fellows, experts and customers.
•	Led Customer Advisory Board meetings to gather input and feedback on technologies and strategic direction.

•	Designed and delivered marketing programs to represent joint positioning of Cisco and alliance partners. 
•	Responsible for staffing and managing marketing teams, vendor negotiations and contracting, budget planning and expense management, quarterly reporting and overall department operations.

•	Established company planning and operations practices for start-up providing wireless access in airports; partnered with Delta Airlines for launch in US airport lounges; led integration with LapTop Lane.
